parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The current page number for paged queries. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paged queries. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: PolicyType
parameters.description:
The policy type. Valid values:

- **DomainBlacklist**: Domain blacklist.

- **DomainWhitelist**: Domain whitelist.

- **SoftwareBlock**: Software disable.

- **AppUninstall**: Terminal uninstall.

- **DlpSend**: File outbound.

- **PeripheralBlock**: Peripheral control.

parameters.name: SchemaName
parameters.description: The template name. It can be 1 to 128 characters long. It supports Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase English letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
